name: What are gutter guards, and are they necessary?

mainEntity.name: What are gutter guards, and are they necessary?

acceptedAnswer.text: Gutter guards are protective covers installed over gutters to prevent leaves, twigs, and other debris from entering and clogging the system while still allowing water to flow through. While not strictly necessary for all homes, they can significantly reduce the frequency of gutter cleaning, especially in areas with many trees. Gutter guards can extend the life of your gutters by preventing debris buildup that can lead to rust and overflow. They are an investment that can save time and prevent potential water damage.
acceptedAnswer.description: Gutter guards are covers that prevent debris from clogging gutters, reducing cleaning needs and preventing potential water damage, especially for homes near trees.
